name: io.github.EzkielynaGroup/ai-model-status-mcp
title: AI Model Status
description: Live uptime, latency, prices and weekly usage of AI models from public data. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: AI_MODEL_STATUS_IDR_PER_USD
environmentVariables.description: Rupiah per USD for the approximate IDR prices (default 15000)

environmentVariables.name: AI_MODEL_STATUS_CACHE_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache per data file in ms (default 60000)

environmentVariables.name: AI_MODEL_STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout per data request in ms (default 15000)
